title: Tech Note: 4D Quick Report Editor Source Code - Part III

historical_commentary.text: This is the third and final installment of a series walking through the source code behind 4D's built-in Quick Report Editor wizard, assuming readers are already familiar with Parts I and II. Quick Report is a long-standing classic-language reporting feature; while it (or a similarly named successor) persists in some form in current 4D, more demanding reporting needs today are typically met with 4D Write Pro or List Box-based reports, making a deep source-code walkthrough of the original wizard's classic implementation primarily of value to developers maintaining legacy Quick-Report-based code.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro (introduced 2016) provides substantially more powerful document/report generation than the classic Quick Report tool this series dissects
List Box-based custom reporting (leveraging the List Box object's growing capabilities) has become a common modern alternative to the built-in Quick Report wizard for many reporting needs
